description: This file implements a React component plugin for draggable blocks within a Lexical editor, including drag-and-drop and touch interactions, positioning, and rendering of UI elements like menus and target lines.

methods.name: getCurrentIndex
methods.description: Calculates the current index for node selection based on previous index and total number of keys.

methods.name: getTopLevelNodeKeys
methods.description: Retrieves the keys of top-level nodes in the Lexical editor state.

methods.name: elementContainingEventLocation
methods.description: Determines if an event location is within an element, considering child elements for list items.

methods.name: getBlockElement
methods.description: Finds the block element at a given event location within the editor.

methods.name: isOnMenu
methods.description: Checks if an element is part of the draggable block menu.

methods.name: setMenuPosition
methods.description: Positions the draggable menu relative to a target element.

methods.name: setDragImage
methods.description: Sets the drag image for a drag operation.

methods.name: setTargetLine
methods.description: Positions the line indicating the drop target during drag-and-drop.

methods.name: useDraggableBlockMenu
methods.description: React hook that manages the draggable block menu UI and interactions, including drag-and-drop and touch events.
